name: Star Health
aliases: star health and allied insurance company limited
star health and allied insurance company ltd
star health and allied insurance co ltd
scope: General India health hospitalization guidance; exact policy, edition, endorsements and TPA instructions must be checked separately.

sources.title: Reimbursement claim form linked from official claims page

timelines.label: Emergency intimation
timelines.text: Claims page asks for notification within 24 hours of hospitalization.

timelines.label: Planned cashless intimation
timelines.text: Cashless Anywhere guidance specifies notification 48 hours before admission; confirm the applicable arrangement with the hospital.

timelines.label: Reimbursement submission: conflicting sources
timelines.text: Claims page says 15 days after discharge; its linked reimbursement form says 30 days. Contact Star Health promptly to confirm the deadline for your policy. ClaimWeave cannot determine a single deadline from these sources.

documents.name: Signed claim form, discharge summary, itemized hospital bill and payment receipts
Prescriptions, pharmacy bills and investigation reports with supporting bills
Bank payment details and applicable KYC documents
Accident records, implant invoices/stickers or other treatment-specific records, where applicable

submission.text: Use the customer portal/app or a branch/advisor. The claims page also instructs sending original reimbursement documents by post or courier. Confirm the destination before sending originals.

cashless.text: Ask the hospital insurance desk to coordinate pre-authorization and confirm the hospital arrangement with Star Health.

name: HDFC ERGO
aliases: hdfc ergo general insurance company limited
hdfc ergo general insurance company ltd
hdfc ergo general insurance co ltd
scope: General India health hospitalization guidance; exact policy, edition, endorsements and TPA instructions must be checked separately.

links.label: Get the current health claim form

timelines.label: Planned reimbursement intimation
timelines.text: Notify HDFC ERGO at least 48 hours before planned hospitalization.

timelines.label: Emergency reimbursement intimation
timelines.text: Notify HDFC ERGO within 24 hours of emergency hospitalization.

timelines.label: Document submission deadline
timelines.text: No universal submission deadline was established from the reviewed process page. Check your policy and confirm with the insurer or TPA.

documents.name: Signed claim form with policy number and original discharge summary
Itemized final hospital bill, payment receipts, pharmacy invoices with prescriptions and investigation reports
NEFT details and cancelled cheque or bank-attested passbook; KYC for claims of INR 1 lakh or more
Implant invoice/sticker, past treatment records and MLC/FIR where applicable

submission.text: Follow the reimbursement page for the signed form and supporting documents. Verify the current submission channel and destination with the insurer before dispatch.

cashless.text: Use HDFC ERGO's official claims guidance and ask the hospital insurance desk to confirm pre-authorization requirements for your policy.

name: Niva Bupa
aliases: niva bupa health insurance company limited
niva bupa health insurance company ltd
niva bupa health insurance co ltd
scope: General India health hospitalization guidance; exact policy, edition, endorsements and TPA instructions must be checked separately.

timelines.label: Reimbursement submission
timelines.text: The claim portal asks for submission within 30 days of discharge. Confirm applicability against your policy and claim type.

timelines.label: Planned cashless notification
timelines.text: Contact the insurer/hospital insurance desk at least 48 hours before treatment.

timelines.label: Emergency cashless notification
timelines.text: Contact the insurer/hospital insurance desk within 24 hours of admission.

documents.name: Discharge summary, itemized hospital bill, receipts, prescriptions and pharmacy bills
Investigation reports and cancelled cheque with account details
KYC for claims of INR 1 lakh or more; accident, implant and diagnosis-specific records where applicable
Complete the reimbursement form and check its signature requirements

submission.text: Submit through the official document-upload portal. Keep originals because the insurer may request them. Portal uploads allow common image formats and PDF, up to 5 MB per file.

cashless.text: Present policy/health-card details at the hospital insurance desk; the hospital submits pre-authorization. Confirm hospital eligibility using the official portal.

name: Care Health
scope: General India health hospitalization guidance; exact policy, edition, endorsements and TPA instructions must be checked separately.

links.label: Get the current claim or pre-authorization form

timelines.label: Planned hospitalization notification
timelines.text: Care's guidance specifies a 48-hour notification window for planned hospitalization. Confirm timing before admission with the insurer/TPA.

timelines.label: Emergency notification
timelines.text: Notify Care within 24 hours of emergency hospitalization.

timelines.label: Document submission deadline
timelines.text: No universal submission deadline was established from the reviewed page. Check your policy and confirm the applicable deadline with Care or your TPA.

documents.name: Signed claim form, policy details and policyholder identity proof
Original hospital bills, receipts and discharge summary
Prescriptions and investigation reports; indoor case papers where requested

submission.text: Use Care's official claims assistance to confirm your submission channel and required originals. Obtain the form for your product from the official forms page.

cashless.text: Show your policy/health card at the hospital insurance desk; the hospital coordinates pre-authorization with Care.
